  "clinicalEncounterId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "createdByMembershipId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "description" text NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "organizationId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "patientId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "rowVersion" int4 DEFAULT 1 NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'RECORDED' NOT NULL,
  "targetDescription" text,
  "targetType" text NOT NULL,
  "toothNumber" text,
  "treatmentProcedureId" uuid,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,

  "voidReason" text,
  "voidedAt" timestamptz,
  "voidedByMembershipId" uuid,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "ClinicalEncounterProcedure_version_dd7c92f3" CHECK ("rowVersion" > 0),
  CONSTRAINT "encounter_procedure_description_89a34e41" CHECK (length(btrim("description")) > 0),
  CONSTRAINT "encounter_procedure_status_5eb91a7c" CHECK ("status" IN ('RECORDED', 'VOIDED')),
  CONSTRAINT "encounter_procedure_target_57de7bf8" CHECK (("targetType" = 'TOOTH' AND "toothNumber" IS NOT NULL AND length(btrim("toothNumber")) > 0) OR ("targetType" <> 'TOOTH' AND "toothNumber" IS NULL)),
  CONSTRAINT "encounter_procedure_target_type_f0db201c" CHECK ("targetType" IN ('TOOTH', 'REGION', 'WHOLE_MOUTH', 'OTHER')),
